correctness.rationale: The map is conformal onto a translated convex sector, with \(f(0)=0\) and \(f'(0)=1\). Differentiation gives \(A(w)=(1+w)(1+\sqrt w)/(4\sqrt w)\) and \(P(w)=(1+3w^2)/(4w)\). At \(w=i/\sqrt3\), \(u>9/16\) and \(v>0\), while the exact formula for \(\operatorname{Im}C_a\) is positive for every \(0<a<1\). On \(w=iy\), \(y\uparrow1/\sqrt3\), the factor \(P(iy)=i(3y^2-1)/(4y)\) approaches zero from the negative imaginary side, so \(\operatorname{Re}(C_a/P)\) tends to \(-\infty\). Interior approximations exist by continuity. At \(a=0\), \(h=1\); at \(a=1\), the reciprocal convexity factor has positive real part. The proof supplies universal quantifiers, and the computations are corroborative only.
